definition.proposition: On out-of-corpus Python (the 330-file SQ99 set, about 31 packages), the looped full-precision assembled model A2f beats the unshared GDN hybrid E24 at matched analytic training FLOPs by about 1.9% in bits per char (200M tokens of code-py-v2), reversing its +2.5% deficit on in-corpus clean80.

scope.dataset: SQ99 out-of-corpus set (330 local library files, K9-scanner overlap < 20%) vs code-py-v2 clean80-300
scope.architecture: A2f (shared 6x2 GDN-hybrid core, contractive inject) vs E24 (12 unshared GDN-hybrid blocks)

definition.refutation_criteria: REFUTED if a second out-of-corpus set (SQ405 temporal holdout or another held-out package set) gives a paired-by-seed 95% CI for A2f - E24 at or above 0

qual: registered (SQ400 P7), 6 seeds, CI excludes 0; one out-of-corpus set
reason: A2f - E24 out of corpus = -1.91%, paired-by-seed 95% CI [-3.40, -0.40], df 5, seeds 2-7; per seed +0.42 / -3.47 / -1.24 / -3.18 / -2.39 / -1.55. Registered P7 ('CI includes 0 or favours the looped A2f') met in its stronger branch. Point estimate beyond the 1% practical margin. LR: A2f is LR-robust at 6e-3 (A3 amendment 2) and E24 runs at its tuned 3e-3. Descriptive companions (not registered predictions): A3mx - E24 -2.82% [-5.04, -0.54] (n 3), A2s - E24 -1.50% [-2.36, -0.63] (n 6), against in-corpus +3.68% and +11.65%.

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the event was recorded

limitations.text: One out-of-corpus set (330 files, 31 packages); the package-level and leave-one-package-out readouts are in SQ400.md. Out-of-corpus losses are 6-7x higher, which compresses magnitudes (it cannot flip a sign). Matched analytic FLOPs; A2f has 18.2M vs E24 29.2M total params. 200M tokens only.

Two shifts are mixed: the SQ99 files are unseen (no train overlap) AND library-style code (stdlib / site-packages), unlike the OpenCoder corpus. C214 cannot separate unseen-document generalisation from a style shift; SQ415 (training filtered for overlap with the SQ99 set) and SQ416 (a prose slice) address it.
